exposure: pregnancy weight gain z-scores above IOM recommendations
pregnancy weight gain z-scores below IOM recommendations
pregnancy weight gain z-scores within IOM recommendations
cohort: The study included 1852 nulliparous women with prepregnancy overweight or obesity.
finding: Pregnancy weight gain z-scores below the lower limit of the IOM recommendations were not associated with a severity-weighted composite outcome of 10 adverse maternal and child health outcomes.
